$comment: Fee models and scanner thresholds for prediction markets. Data, not constants: edit this file (or pass an override to the scanner) to change what counts as an opportunity. A fee model is applied per contract at the price it is bought. kinds: bps_of_notional (price * bps / 10000), p_one_minus_p (rate * price * (1 - price), the published exchange schedule shape), flat_per_contract (usd). `providers` is keyed by the provider id the venue reports on a market; an id with no entry falls back to `default_provider`, set to the steepest published schedule so an unknown provider can only understate an edge, never overstate it. `venue` is charged by the Solana venue on top of the provider. Until a quote reports the venue's real fee (quote.fees_usd on a preview), the venue entry is a conservative allowance, so a reported edge is never overstated.
